code: library(daltoolbox) library(heimdall)  # This example assumes a model residual where 1 is an error and 0 is a # correct prediction.  data(st_drift_examples) data <- st_drift_examples$univariate data$event <- NULL  model <- dfr_page_hinkley(target_feat='serie')  detection <- NULL output <- list(obj=model, drift=FALSE) for (i in seq_along(data$serie)){  output <- update_state(output$obj, data$serie[i])  if (output$drift){    type <- 'drift'    output$obj <- reset_state(output$obj)  }else{    type <- ''  }  detection <- rbind(detection, data.frame(idx=i, event=output$drift, type=type)) }  detection[detection$type == 'drift',] #>     idx event  type #> 205 205  TRUE drift

title: heimdall 1.3.0
text: norm() renamed nrm_base() longer exported. old name masked base::norm() whenever package attached. Code called heimdall::norm() must updated nrm_base(); nrm_memory() unaffected. update_state() now returns list(obj =, drift =) every detector, including base drifter method dfr_inactive / dfr_passive baselines. Previously returned object , broke streaming loop shown every example. update_state.stealthy() follows contract now updates correct field (referenced non-existent drift_technique slot). reticulate moved Imports Suggests. dfr_adwin() needs , now fails actionable message Python numpy missing. Config/reticulate longer declares torch, scipy, pandas, matplotlib scikit-learn, never used. car ggplot2 dropped Imports. Levene’s test now computed internally (Brown-Forsythe variant, median-centred), ggplot2 never used R/. dfr_mcdd() dfr_lbdd() now trim window recent half drift reported, reset_state() preserves window. matches dfr_kldist() dfr_kswin() already .

title: heimdall 1.3.0
text: fit() longer breaks stream single observation. dfr_cusum, dfr_ddm, dfr_ecdd, dfr_eddm dfr_hddm used 2:length(data), reversed c(2, 1) processed non-existent element followed duplicate first one. mt_fscore() now uses f argument beta F-beta score. previously stored parameter always computed F1. inverse_transform.nrm_memory() now inverts data given instead internal history, ignored. fit.nrm_memory() longer emits spurious warning injects row zeros history first call. dfr_ecdd() longer fails object 'control_limit' found average run lengths 1000; argument validated front. dfr_hddm() dfr_aedd() longer latch per-call drift flag. drift element returned update_state() refers current call; obj$drifted remains sticky reset_state(). dfr_mcdd() longer stores incoming observation twice window full drift detected. dfr_lbdd() longer discards incoming observation drift detected. levene criterion dfr_aedd() longer fails multivariate input; previous implementation referenced hard-coded V1 column never created. dfr_multi_criteria() validates drifter_list combination instead failing later object 'has_drift' found silently reusing previous detector’s output. dfr_mcdd() falls back nonparametric test windows larger 5000 observations, shapiro.test() undefined. Missing values now handled consistently: error-based detectors treat NA correct prediction, distribution-based detectors skip observation. dfr_eddm() dfr_hddm() previously raised error NA.

title: heimdall 1.3.0
text: duplicated update_state() generic removed. remaining one keeps ..., matching every method documentation. Cross-references ?dd_ddm, ?hcd_ddm ?nrm_mimax, topics package, replaced runnable examples. dist_based(), mv_dist_based(), dfr_multi_criteria(), fit.drifter() dummy detectors gained examples. dfr_adwin() example longer commented ; runs Python runtime numpy available. dfr_aedd() example points walkthrough actually exists repository. dfr_kldist() documents p_th divergence threshold, p-value, dfr_kswin() documents reference window randomly subsampled.
